# Scalistic

> Scalistic is a survey distribution platform and verified respondent provider under Research Synergy Foundation. It connects researchers, academics, organizations, and businesses with 45,000+ verified respondents across Indonesia and globally for research, academic studies, market surveys, program evaluation, and strategic business needs.

## Key Facts
- Parent: Research Synergy Foundation (https://www.researchsynergy.org)
- Verified respondents: 45,000+ worldwide
- Minimum order (IDR): Rp 21,000 — 30 respondents × 2 questions × Rp 350 per response
- Minimum order (USD): $3.00 — 30 respondents × 2 questions × $0.05 per response unit
- Question constraints: minimum 2, maximum 30 per survey
- International respondent weight: counted 2× in IDR pricing
- Languages: Indonesian, English
- Country: Indonesia
- Contact: researchsynergy.institute@gmail.com, +62 811-2317-334

## Services for Clients (Researchers / Businesses)
Scalistic distributes surveys to verified respondents matching the client's criteria. Workflow is 5 steps: Inquiry → Setup → Live Survey → Verification → Completion. Use cases include undergraduate / master / doctoral thesis research, academic research, market and consumer research, organizational surveys, program and policy evaluation, business strategy research, social and health studies.

- Client registration (ID): https://bit.ly/reg-scalistic
- Client registration (Global): https://bit.ly/scalistic-global

## For Respondents
Respondents register, participate in available surveys, earn points, and redeem points for benefits that support academic and professional development.

Point system:
- Survey with fewer than 30 questions: 20 points
- Survey with 30 questions: 30 points

Claimable benefits (starting point costs):
- National Webinar — from 80 points
- International Webinar — from 120 points
- E-course — from 150 points
- E-book — from 60 points
- Paper Review Service — from 180 points
- Proofreading — from 180 points
- Free APC Journal — from 300 points
- E-Coaching — from 200 points
- Conference Virtual Discount — from 150 points
- Free Membership — from 100 points

- Respondent registration (ID): https://forms.gle/U6i9Q92Bd54J1xm48
- Respondent registration (Global): https://forms.gle/gUpjP7AX5YAYRpWt5
